decisions.decision: Choose the parallel packed candidate for fewer pictures; choose a narrow candidate for fewer coded samples. Byte, slice, and retained-slot costs also differ. No candidate is best for every metric.
decisions.qualification: Bounded comparison of two hand-specified scalar-minimum constructions and three construction/schedule combinations per function. Candidate enumeration is not exhaustive; Pareto results apply only to these candidates and this geometry, writer, and retained-reference policy. No general joint optimizer or global optimum for bytes, slices, area, or reference slots is claimed.

metric_meaning.prediction_bytes: actual encoded immutable prediction tail bytes
metric_meaning.prediction_coded_luma_samples: coded width times height times prediction pictures, including guards/unused tiles
metric_meaning.prediction_pictures: computation pictures after two input pictures
